written_rules: Before the base game reel spin initiates, a base game reel set is chosen from multiple possible reel sets.
HORIZONTAL SAW HARD HAT, VERTICAL SAW HARD HAT, HAZARD HARD HAT and SUPER SAW HARD HAT symbols are WILD for HARD HAT symbol.
Before the base game reel spin initiates, a number of positions may be randomly replaced with HARD HAT, HORIZONTAL SAW HARD HAT and/or VERTICAL SAW HARD HAT symbols.

The base game starts with the bottom 3 rows of the grid active. If HAZARD HARD HAT symbol lands on an active row during the base game, then 1-3 additional rows will become active. HAZARD HARD HAT symbol only appears on reels 1, 3, and 5 during the base game.

conditions_triggers.trigger: HAZARD HARD HAT symbol landing on an active row during the base game
